text: POV: you started baking sourdough to be healthy and now you eat half a loaf a day
caption: Please tell me I'm not the only one.
note: Direct remake of the @doughybyzoey reference with our loaf and our own cow.

text: me after "just one slice" of warm focaccia
caption: It was one slice. Then it was the edges. Then it was gone.

text: the cake serves 20. my family of 4:
caption: Celebration cakes from £45, serve about 20. Allegedly.

text: me in the car park after collecting the cinnamon buns "for the family"
caption: They were for the family. The family got four.

text: me after one "small" slice of banana loaf
caption: Small is a state of mind.

text: me waddling to the kitchen at 2am to check if the dough has proofed
caption: It had not proofed. I went back to bed. I came back at 3.

text: naming your sourdough starter took longer than naming your actual children
caption: Drop your starter's name below. Ours has one and we are not telling.

text: my starter has a name, a feeding schedule and a better routine than me
caption: Fed twice a day. Never misses. Unlike me.

text: day 4 of your first starter: "it's dead"
text2: it's not dead. it's day 4. keep feeding it.
caption: Day four is where most starters get thrown away. Do not. It is a normal dip, and it comes back.
note: Ties to the starter guide's own 'day four' line. Use STARTER keyword once set up.

text: the 3 days it takes to make one sourdough loaf
text2: the 4 minutes it takes the family to finish it
caption: Three days of fermenting. Four minutes of silence at the table.

text: "it's just flour, water and salt"
text2: then why did it take three days and my whole weekend
caption: Three ingredients. Unlimited patience.
check: Only say flour, water and salt for loaves where that is the exact recipe.

text: nobody:
text2: sourdough people at every party: "so what hydration are you running"
caption: Ours depends on the loaf. Ask us at collection.

text: when someone cuts the sourdough while it's still hot
caption: Let it cool. An hour. We know. We know.

text: me checking on the dough every 20 minutes like it's a newborn
caption: It is fine. It was fine twenty minutes ago.

text: throwing away 100g of discard every day like flour grows on trees
caption: What do you do with yours? Best answer gets a shout out.

text: mum: we have bread at home
caption: When your mum runs a bakery, the bread at home goes hard. In a good way.

text: me at 4:59pm on a thursday adding one more thing to the basket
caption: Orders close at 5pm Thursday. We see you.

text: "it's homemade" (it was made in a home. just not mine)
caption: We won't tell. Celebration cakes need 10 days' notice.

text: being the one who brings a box of cupcakes into the office on friday
caption: Office orders and events: tell us what you need at the link in bio.

text: saturday 8am. the only alarm I don't snooze.
caption: Collection and local delivery, Saturday 8am to midday.

text: brioche buns turning a normal tuesday burger into a whole event
caption: Brioche buns, box of 6, £5.50. Freeze well. Not that they last.

text: the last cookie in the box when it hears you get home
caption: It knows. It always knows.

text: the cinnamon bun watching you say "I'm being good this week"
caption: Sure you are.

text: the pretzel when you said you'd share
caption: Pretzels, £3.25 each. Buy two. Save a friendship.

text: medway seagulls when you walk out of collection with a fresh loaf
caption: Hold it with both hands. We have seen things.

text: the seagull that watched you eat a pretzel on the high street
caption: He is not sorry. He will be back.

text: me after "sharing" the cookies with the kids
caption: Box of 6. Split it fairly. (We know you won't.)

text: me walking back from the kitchen after "just checking" the party cupcakes
caption: Cupcakes, box of 6. Count them before the party.

text: my starter after I missed ONE feed (she is fighting for her life)
caption: She will be fine. Usually. If yours isn't, our free starter guide walks you through it.
note: Research theme 5; feeds the starter rescue guide.

text: "sorry, can't come out tonight. I have to feed my starter."
caption: A real excuse. We've used it.

text: sourdough starter names that go hard:
text2: clint yeastwood. bread pitt. doughlly parton.
caption: Yours? Best name in the comments wins bragging rights.
note: Pun one-liners had the highest share rate in the meme research (median 0.29% shares per play).

text: POV: friday night in a family bakery. nobody is going out. the dough is proofing.
caption: Saturday's orders, packed with care. See you 8am.

text: a cookie with personality
caption: Chocolate chip cookies, box of 6, £4.25. Each one has opinions.
note: Echoes cookiemookie_uk 'cookie with personality', 1.68% shares per play.
